en_title: Former PlayStation Boss Says Sony Doesn't Need a 'PS6 for $1,200,' It Needs a 'PS5 for $300'
cn_title: 前PlayStation负责人称索尼不需要「1200美元的PS6」，而需要「300美元的PS5」
opus_summary: PlayStation前负责人Shawn Layden表示，索尼的创新不应来自制造1200美元(约合人民币8016元)的PS6，而应是推出300美元(约合人民币2004元)的PS5。他认为现有硬件性能已足够，索尼应设法降低PS5成本，而非迭代主机。索尼此前称仍在决定下一代主机的推出时间。

paragraphs.en: Former PlayStation boss Shawn Layden said he thinks innovation at Sony shouldn't come "from making a PS6 for $1,200" but from making "another PS5 for $300."
paragraphs.cn: 前PlayStation负责人Shawn Layden表示，他认为索尼的创新不应来自「制造一台1200美元的PS6」，而应来自制造「另一台300美元的PS5」。

paragraphs.en: As tech costs skyrocket and rumors of pricey gaming consoles swirl, the former president and CEO of Sony Interactive Entertainment America took the time during an appearance on The Trophy Room podcast to encourage the PlayStation maker to consider an unexpected, cheaper course of action. Pointing out how previous hardware leaps have typically offered clearly identifiable innovative qualities from generation to generation, he touched on why the PlayStation 6 simply leaning on "more ray tracing and more teraflops" might not be the best idea.
paragraphs.cn: 随着技术成本飙升、有关高价游戏主机的传闻四起，这位索尼互动娱乐美国前总裁兼首席执行官在播客节目《The Trophy Room》中抽出时间，敦促这家PlayStation制造商考虑一条出人意料、成本更低的行动路线。他指出，以往的硬件飞跃通常会在世代更迭中带来清晰可辨的创新特性，并谈到了为什么PlayStation 6单纯依靠「更多光线追踪和更多万亿次浮点运算」或许不是最好的主意。

paragraphs.en: As Layden put it, "I think we have enough power in the machine."
paragraphs.cn: 用Layden的话说：「我认为这台机器的性能已经足够了。」

paragraphs.en: "The innovation needs to come not from making PS6 for $1,200. It's to make another PS5 for $300," he added. "Now, that would be true innovation. This is the first platform that I've seen that has gone up in price over time. I mean, PS2, at the end of the PS2 era, it was $99. You could buy a PS2 for $99."
paragraphs.cn: 他补充道：「创新不应来自制造1200美元的PS6，而是制造另一台300美元的PS5。那才是真正的创新。这是我见过的第一个随着时间推移而涨价的平台。我的意思是，在PS2时代末期，PS2只卖99美元。你花99美元就能买一台PS2。」

paragraphs.en: The PS5 launched almost exactly six years ago with two primary options for players to choose from: a base version with a disc drive for $499, and a Digital Edition for $399. What seemed like relatively fair price points in 2020 now seems almost like a steal thanks to a series of price increases in recent years. Today, buying a base PS5 directly from PlayStation costs $649, a Digital Edition costs $599, and a Pro costs an unbelievable $899 (up $200 from its reveal price ). Things get even worse when you look at retailers like GameStop .
paragraphs.cn: PS5于差不多整整六年前推出，当时为玩家提供了两个主要选择：售价499美元、配有光驱的基础版，以及售价399美元的数字版。由于近年来的一系列涨价，2020年看似相对合理的价格如今几乎像是在捡便宜。如今，直接从PlayStation购买一台基础版PS5需要649美元，数字版需要599美元，而Pro的价格高达令人难以置信的899美元（比公布时的价格上涨了200美元）。看看GameStop等零售商的情况，事情就更糟了。

paragraphs.en: Sony has put the blame on "continued pressures in the global economic landscape ," but that's done little to lessen the sting for the average buyer. As console sales for Sony, Microsoft , and Nintendo suffer, Layden is of the mind that Sony shouldn't be looking for a way to get to a likely more expensive future but instead a cheaper past.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼将此归咎于「全球经济形势下持续存在的压力」，但这并没有多少减轻普通消费者的痛苦。随着索尼、微软和任天堂的主机销量受到影响，Layden认为，索尼不应寻求通往一个可能更加昂贵的未来，而应回到一个更加便宜的过去。

paragraphs.en: "I think if I were in their shoes, that's what I'd be doing. I'd be trying to find a way to get the cost down on the 5," he added.
paragraphs.cn: 他补充道：「我认为，如果我处在他们的位置上，我就会这么做。我会努力寻找降低PS5成本的方法。」

paragraphs.en: Later, he continued: "It's a hard place to be right now, I think. What the company needs to do is do what it's never done, which is, don't iterate the console. Make it smaller, make it cheaper, do all the things you can around that, but the silicon's fine, the OS is fine. It's more than enough power to build the kind of games all of us want to play."
paragraphs.cn: 随后，他继续说道：「我认为现在的处境很艰难。公司需要做的是做它从未做过的事，也就是不要迭代主机。让它变得更小、更便宜，围绕这些目标做一切能做的事，但芯片没问题，操作系统也没问题。它的性能完全足以制作我们所有人都想玩的那类游戏。」

paragraphs.en: If you look at the raw console release timeline, we're just about due for the next PlayStation, but many players say they don't want to see a PS6 announced until hardware prices come down. In May, Sony said it was still trying to decide when its next console should launch . It followed a February report that stated the company was considering pushing the device to 2028 – or even 2029 – following previous 2027 launch expectations.
paragraphs.cn: 如果单看主机发布时间线，下一代PlayStation差不多该来了，但许多玩家表示，他们不希望在硬件价格下降之前看到PS6公布。今年5月，索尼表示仍在设法决定下一代主机应于何时推出。在此之前，2月的一篇报道称，该公司正考虑将这款设备推迟到2028年甚至2029年推出，而此前的预期发布时间是2027年。

paragraphs.en: For now, however, we know distressingly little about the PS6. As PlayStation continues battling the backlash against its decision to kill physical discs , one leaker has said RAM and storage for the console alone could cost as much as $680 . Meanwhile, an October patent suggested Sony may be looking into taking advantage of its own take on frame generation . How much the PS6 will cost when all is said and done is a mystery, but the future isn't looking particularly bright .
paragraphs.cn: 不过，目前我们对PS6的了解少得令人沮丧。PlayStation仍在应对其取消实体光盘的决定所引发的强烈反对，一位爆料者则表示，这款主机的内存和存储成本加起来就可能高达680美元。与此同时，10月的一项专利表明，索尼或许正在研究利用自己开发的帧生成功能。PS6最终会卖多少钱还是个谜，但前景看起来并不特别光明。
